name: What kind of paint finishes are available for interior walls?

mainEntity.name: What kind of paint finishes are available for interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common interior paint finishes include flat (matte), eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and high-gloss. Flat offers a non-reflective look, while eggshell and satin provide more durability and a slight sheen, making them popular for living areas. Semi-gloss and high-gloss are highly durable and reflective, often used for trim, doors, and high-traffic areas like kitchens and bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Interior paint finishes range from flat (matte) for a non-reflective look to high-gloss for durability and sheen, suitable for various room types.
